column1: # The Computer Science Ontology as a term taxonomy: the topics computer science research is
# indexed by, each with the label CSO states for it and the equivalent labels it states beside it.
# CSO states NO definition for any topic, so this is matched against declared names like OLiA and
# FIBO and cannot be read as a functional taxonomy — there is no prose to compare a scope against.
# Columns: concept, prefLabel, altLabel, broader, kind, module, definition, note.
# definition is empty for every row because CSO publishes none.
# CSO is a POLY-HIERARCHY: 9927 of its 14624 topics with a parent are stated beneath more than one, up
# to 33. Every parent is carried, joined with the separator SkosConcept states for a repeated
# property, and SkosConcept.broaderConcepts reads them back. Nothing is dropped.
# Source: CSO 3.5, https://cso.kmi.open.ac.uk/download (CSO.3.5.csv; the download states no
#   revision, so there is no commit to pin and the archive is the citation).
# Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0) — "you can freely copy,
#   share, adapt, and build upon the data for any purpose, including commercial use, as long as
#   you give appropriate credit to the original creators". Credit: the Computer Science Ontology,
#   Knowledge Media Institute, The Open University, and NOTICE.md carries it.
#   The downloaded archive itself states no licence and carries no licence file; these terms were
#   supplied by the maintainer of this repository rather than read from the archive.
